The Crowdsourcing Service Providers industry is composed of companies that operate crowdsourcing
platforms. Industry operators provide access to temporary employees, typically through an
network. These employees work on a project-by-project basis, either online or in person. Unlike traditional
outsourcing companies, industry operators do not directly employ crowdsourced workers. Instead,
industry operators simply provide a platform for businesses and workers to communicate and collaborate
on projects. In general, crowdsourcing service providers intend to provide businesses with easier access to
individuals with skills that their other employees may lack, making it easier to tackle business problems
without hiring a full employee. Crowdsourcing companies generate revenue by taking a percentage of fees
that businesses pay for crowdsourced projects.
